The '''''Interrogator''''' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] under the command of [[High Inquisitor]] [[Antinnis Tremayne]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jovan Vharing]] was captain of the ship shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], although his command did not last long. The ''Interrogator'' was responsible for the [[Attack on Qlothos|bombing]] of a [[Unidentified capital city (Qlothos)|settlement]] on [[Qlothos]] that took the life of a prominent [[Unidentified Kuat Drive Yards engineer|engineer]] from [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], including his family.
